messages:
anna-partner: Hey team — HPCCo asked for a firm driver/CUDA/ROCm matrix for the marketplace image cut next week. We need a clear fallback plan if a pinned combo regresses.

mike-eng: thanks. Can you share which SKUs/regions are in scope?

anna-partner: US-east + eu-west for initial launch. SKUs: g4dn, a100-40g, h100. Partner asked we pin to driver 535.86 / CUDA 12.2 / ROCm 5.7, but they're open to alternatives if we can show perf parity.

sofia-ops: timeline note: release branch freeze is Thu 09:00 PT. If we do a hotfix after that we need marketplace approval and a new image build. Prefer to avoid last-minute pins.

raj-sre: if 535.86 is the partner-requested driver, we should test a rollback path to 532.x and to an older CUDA-compatible ROCm variant. Need an automatic routing rule for regen requests pointing to fallback model variants in case of runtime OOMs or kernel errors.

simon-partner: HPCCo engineering here — we validated 535.86 on our infra for perf but saw increased mem fragmentation on h100 in long-running streams. We can run a quick patch build with our driver team but timeline is tight.

mike-eng: ok. Proposal: pin primary to 535.86 + CUDA12.2 for the marketplace image. Add two fallback lanes: 1) driver 532.61 + CUDA12.1, 2) driver 525.x + ROCm5.6 for onprem customers. We'll document known regressions and enable automatic region fallback to the 532 lane for 24h if we detect >5% error rate.

anna-partner: sounds good. Simon, can your team confirm whether the fragmentation is specific to our long-stream workload or general? If it's only the long streams maybe we can mitigate with KV cache TTL tweaks in the runtime.

simon-partner: I'll run the long-stream repro and get logs by EOD. If it's general we'll push a hotfix; if not we'll share config fixes.

deploy-bot: CI: marketplace-image-build #142 queued

sofia-ops: linking the minimal test matrix we want in CI: ```
- SKUs: g4dn, a100-40g, h100
- Drivers: 535.86 (primary), 532.61 (fallback-1), 525.85 (fallback-2)
- CUDA/ROCm: CUDA12.2, CUDA12.1, ROCm5.6
- Tests: startup-time, 8hr sustained stream, 99p latency, OOM/regression smoke
```

raj-sre: add a kernel-crash detector and automatic rollout rollback: if kernel_error_rate > 0.5% over 30m, route traffic to fallback-1 and create an incident. Also ensure metrics are tagged with driver+cuda versions.

mike-eng: I'll prep the matrix PR and include per-SKU notes. Also adding a canary tag in marketplace for the first 1% traffic for 12h.

anna-partner: thanks — Simon, ping us when you have logs. Sofia/mike/raj, let's meet tomorrow 09:30 PT to sign off the image and the rollback playbook. :thumbsup:
